lines.en: Hi Omar! Did you watch the documentary about rising sea levels last night?
Hi Sara. I did. The report warned that millions could be forced to leave their homes.
What makes climate change so unfair is that its worst effects will be felt by those who caused it least.
However rich a nation may be, it cannot protect itself alone from a global crisis.
Rarely has the world needed cooperation as urgently as it does today.
On a happier note, I finally visited the new museum downtown.
What amazes visitors is not only the size of the temples, but the precision with which they were built.
Exactly. And it is believed that the pyramids were built by paid workers rather than slaves.
Were these monuments to be destroyed, no money in the world could ever rebuild them.
What a nation preserves of its past tells you a great deal about how it sees its future.
The museum had a whole hall about inventions. Did you see it?
I did. Not only did the printing press spread knowledge, but it also changed who was allowed to have it.
It is often a simple frustration that leads to the most useful inventions.
What drives most inventors is not money, but the joy of solving a problem nobody else could solve.
Speaking of people, how is your grandmother? You two are very close.
She is well. What holds our family together is not the absence of conflict, but the willingness to forgive.
However busy life becomes, we should never be too busy for the people we love.
It is often the smallest act of kindness that a person remembers for the rest of their life.
Were people to listen more and judge less, most conflicts would disappear within minutes.
That sounds like something my grandmother would say.
By the way, were you nervous about flying after that news story about the storm?
A little. But it is impossible to remove all risk from life; the best we can do is to manage it wisely.
It is often the risks we ignore, not the ones we fear, that end up hurting us.
Not until something goes wrong do most people take warnings seriously.
Rarely does fear protect us as well as preparation does.
Wise as always. So, same time next month?
Were you to suggest anything else, I would refuse. Our talks are the highlight of my month.
Little did I expect, when we first met, that these conversations would matter so much to me.
Take care, Omar. Give my love to your grandmother.
I will. See you soon, Sara.
